title: US monthly equity expiration (January 2027) — the last NYSE session before the January FOMC blackout opens
source: EST: two independent Cboe primary surfaces on one file, plus weekday arithmetic, all fetched direct 2026-09-06. (1) DIRECT LISTING: www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200 after one 301, 1,731 bytes) carries the live S&P 500 Variance futures row `VA,VA/F7,2027-01-15,298.25` — a real daily settlement price against an expiration dated 2027-01-15 itself, the same class of evidence by which opex-2027-06-17 was filed off `VA,VA/M7,2027-06-17,319.25`. (2) CONTRACT SPEC, INDEPENDENTLY: the same file returns `VX,VX/Z6,2026-12-16,18.975`, and Cboe's VX terms settle to the SOQ of the SPX/SPXW series expiring exactly 30 calendar days later — 2026-12-16 + 30d = 2027-01-15. (3) ARITHMETIC: January 2027's Fridays are the 1st, 8th, 15th, 22nd and 29th, so the third Friday is the 15th, and NYSE's own 2027 holiday column (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, parsed this session) puts January's only closures on Friday 2027-01-01 and Monday 2027-01-18 (MLK observed) — neither displaces the 15th, so the date is unadjusted. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, because the variance row dates the index leg while a monthly expiration also covers single-stock options, and because theocc.com returned HTTP 403 to this runner on 2026-09-06 (schedules page and expiration-calendar media URL both). `OCC:` is the prefix this class promotes under. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the opex-2027-05-21 initial research (2026-09-06). SCOPE, STATED HONESTLY: this is NOT an adjacency finding — 2027-01-15 is 126 days from the proposer's own event and nowhere near its +/-5-day corridor. It is filed because the proposer's entire reason for existing was that it WAS the hole in this calendar's monthly-expiration run, and the identical check that found that hole (walk the third Fridays this calendar tracks and look for a missing month) finds exactly one more. Leaving a known, doubly-primary-dated, NEARER hole unfilled would repeat the blindness opex-2027-05-21 exists to correct. With both filed, the calendar's opex run is complete and unbroken from 2026-08-21 through 2027-06-17. A later session should read this as a deliberate widening with a stated reason, not as a lane drifting past its brief. WHAT IT IS: an ordinary monthly expiration, not a quarterly triple witching (the 2027 quarterlies are 03-19, 06-17, 09-17, 12-17), so impact MEDIUM to match the class convention this calendar runs at 8 of 9 — quarterlies `high`, monthlies `medium`, per opex-2027-04-16's own note. STRUCTURE, computed this session and worth carrying: the Fed's posted 2027 panel puts the first meeting on Jan 26-27, so the blackout opens 00:00 ET Saturday 2027-01-16 (fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16, already tracked) — the day after this expiration. 2027-01-15 is therefore the LAST NYSE session before that blackout, one of only four 2027 third Fridays in that position (with 04-16, 07-16 and 10-15, all late-month-meeting months), and its whole post-expiration window to the decision is Fed-silent. That is the same structure opex-2027-04-16's ledger analysed at D-223 and asked to be tested somewhere cheaper; this entry is 131 days out, and opex-2026-10-16 (40 days out) is cheaper still. Estimate widens caution only; no house playbook is opex-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-06, zero hits), and nothing here licenses an entry.
